CustomField.formula: If( (Below_Threshold__c && Day_Below_Threshold__c <= VALUE($Label.Threshold_Time_Limit)), IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", "Red",15, (Day_Below_Threshold__c)*5)& IMAGE("/img/samples/color_green.gif", "Green",15, (VALUE($Label.Threshold_Time_Limit)-Day_Below_Threshold__c)*5)&' '&Text(VALUE($Label.Threshold_Time_Limit)-Day_Below_Threshold__c)&' Days','')
CustomField.label: Day Left to Move to Retail
